prompt: Can I carry over unused vacation days into next year?

reply.message: Yes, partly. Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid time off per year, and up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year. Any remaining unused days expire on December 31. Interns accrue 1 day per month, and contractors don't accrue PTO. Book PTO in the HR portal. Absences of 3 or more consecutive working days need 2 weeks' notice.

prompt: Can I work from home a few days a week?

reply.message: Yes. Under POL-REM-01, office-based employees may work remotely up to 2 days a week, as long as the arrangement is agreed with your manager. Fully remote work needs VP approval instead. If you'd like to work from another country, that is allowed for up to 20 working days per calendar year, but it needs HR approval at least 2 weeks in advance.

prompt: How long do I have to submit an expense report?

reply.message: You have 30 days to submit an expense report in the HR portal. Receipts are required for anything over $25. Your manager approves expenses, and a single expense over $1,000 also needs your department head's approval.

prompt: Is there a home office stipend?

reply.message: Yes. Full-time employees can claim a one-time home-office stipend of up to $300 through expenses. Per POL-EQP-01, this is a one-time claim, not a recurring allowance.

prompt: Can I fly premium economy to the Frankfurt conference? It's an 8-hour flight.

reply.message: Yes, premium economy is allowed for flights longer than 6 hours, and an 8-hour flight qualifies. Before you book, you need your manager's approval, and you should book through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead where possible.

prompt: How far ahead should I book work travel?

reply.message: Per POL-TRV-01, book flights and hotels through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead where possible. Travel also needs your manager's approval before you book. For reference, economy is the standard for flights under 6 hours, and premium economy is allowed for longer flights.
